name: Multiple Scattering via Volume Trace Depth
aliases: Volume Trace Depth with Multiple Scattering
definition: A render setting that enables volumetric multiple scattering, required for dense volumes to appear luminous and believable. It works exclusively with Brute Force Global Illumination.
summary: Multiple Scattering via Volume Trace Depth simulates indirect light transport within participating media to create luminous volumes, distinguished by its requirement for Brute Force Global Illumination and exponential computational cost.
